declarations.explanation: Thesis thm:pasting-lemma. A function f out of the disjoint-union metric space is continuous exactly when every restriction f ∘ ι_α : x ↦ f (x, α) is continuous. Lean strategy / thesis relation note: the proof is the thesis's function-level ε-δ argument, not the Sigma-topology shortcut. Forward direction: fix α, x₀ ∈ X_α and a neighbourhood of f (x₀, α); continuity of f at (x₀, α) gives a radius δ, and d((x, α), (x₀, α)) = d_α(x, x₀) (disjointEdist_mk_mk_same) turns it into a radius for f ∘ ι_α at x₀. Converse: fix (x₀, α₀); continuity of f ∘ ι_α₀ at x₀ gives δ₀; with δ = min(δ₀, 1/2) every point within δ of (x₀, α₀) has tag α₀ (tag_eq_of_edist_lt_top), so the component estimate applies. Th

declarations.explanation: Thesis thm:pasting-lemma-measurable. For a countable family of metric spaces, a function f from the disjoint-union metric space (with its Borel sigma-algebra) to a measurable space is measurable exactly when every restriction f ∘ ι_α : x ↦ f (x, α) is Borel measurable. Lean strategy / thesis relation note: the proof follows the thesis's two directions rather than the Sigma-structure bridge. First, ι_α is an isometry onto the open component X_α × α (isometry_sigmaMk, isOpen_range_sigmaMk_metricTopology), hence a homeomorphism onto a Borel set (isOpenEmbedding_sigmaMk_metricTopology). Forward direction: (f ∘ ι_α)⁻¹(B) = ι_α⁻¹(f⁻¹(B)) is Borel because ι_α is continuous. Converse: f⁻¹(B) = ⋃_α

declarations.explanation: Thesis prop:disjoint-partial-order. The order on a disjoint union compares only elements with the same tag, using the order from that component. Instance note: DisjointUnion X is an abbrev for Σ a, X a, so this is a global LE instance on every sigma type with ordered fibres. Mathlib's Mathlib.Data.Sigma.Order declares a global disjoint-sum instance on the same type (Sigma.LE, an inductive relation) that is logically equivalent (Sigma.le_def) but not definitionally equal to this one. No project module currently imports Mathlib.Data.Sigma.Order (checked over the import closure of every module), so the two never coexist. If that import is ever added, make instLE/instPartialOrder scoped and open

declarations.explanation: Thesis thm:pasting-lemma. A function f out of the disjoint-union metric space is continuous exactly when every restriction f ∘ ι_α : x ↦ f (x, α) is continuous. Lean strategy / thesis relation note: the proof is the thesis's function-level ε-δ argument, not the Sigma-topology shortcut. Forward direction: fix α, x₀ ∈ X_α and a neighbourhood of f (x₀, α); continuity of f at (x₀, α) gives a radius δ, and d((x, α), (x₀, α)) = d_α(x, x₀) (disjointEdist_mk_mk_same) turns it into a radius for f ∘ ι_α at x₀. Converse: fix (x₀, α₀); continuity of f ∘ ι_α₀ at x₀ gives δ₀; with δ = min(δ₀, 1/2) every point within δ of (x₀, α₀) has tag α₀ (tag_eq_of_edist_lt_top), so the component estimate applies. Th

declarations.informal: Informal statement: a nonnegative measurable function on a product has measurable partial integrals and equal product and iterated integrals in both orders; an integrable real function has integrable sections almost everywhere and satisfies the analogous two Fubini identities.
